source_snapshot.procedure: Enable persistence, run level 4, then start service.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Generic privileged run with truncated level-4 output and conflicting level-1 request.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require least-privilege identity/device/security matrix and unchanged policy.

old_problem: An unrestricted generic run could bypass the permission boundary under test; the source lacked execution identity, device-node/LSM expectations, named result codes and correct service order.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA defines permissions/OS-block software failures for inaccessible nodes, entity mismatch and file-creation permissions. A signed access matrix can parameterize the intended host/container context without weakening policy.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row355 all 18 XLSX columns and history2951.
Applied official DCGM permissions and OS-related-block check semantics.
No ACL, capability, LSM, service or diagnostic state changed.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 least-privilege permissions and OS-block validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the approved DCGM identity has exactly the required GPU/service/file access, intentional blocks remain enforced, and the documented permission check plus complete level-4 suite behaves as expected.
required_package: Compatible driver/DCGM and GPU entity manifest
Audit collection and safety abort policy
test_case.test_command: Record effective identity, device ACLs and security context without secrets; establish the approved service state, enable persistence only if authorized, run one full level-4 diagnostic under the declared least-privilege context, map permission result codes and all tests/skips, then prove policy and runtime state are unchanged/restored.
test_case.expected_result: Every required operation is allowed, every intentional block remains blocked, the permission software check reports PASS with no unexpected access/entity/file error, all applicable suite tests pass, and no security control is broadened.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is the signed allowed/blocked matrix plus named DCGM result and complete suite accounting; running as unrestricted root or disabling a control cannot satisfy this case.
safety_gate: Security-owner approval of identity and bounded privileged actions
Never change ACL/LSM/cgroup merely to obtain PASS
Drain GPUs and retain OOB access
Preserve audit/full results; abort on health or unexpected privilege event; no retry
expected_evidence: Full level-4 output and permission codes
test_case.recovery: Stop the run on unexpected access or fault, restore only pre-authorized runtime state, verify security policy hashes/settings and GPU health, and escalate without automatic retry.

source_conflict.reason: Official named permission checks, explicit least-privilege context, cumulative level 4 and pre-run service readiness resolve the source gaps.

blocked.reason: The oracle is defined; project security context is a provisionable prerequisite.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind identity/access matrix, expected blocks, security context, package/entities, runtime states and safety limits.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; SECURITY AND INVASIVE RUN APPROVAL REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED
pending.owner: OS security and GPU diagnostics owners.
